title: Use lower case file extensions for document attachment file names
summary: GetAttachmentFileName on Electronic Document Format now lower cases the file extension, so documents saved to disk or zipped through document sending profiles get .pdf, .xml or .zip instead of upper case extensions. The procedure signature and events are unchanged.
key_points: GetAttachmentFileName() method now converts file extensions to lower case when building default file names
Affects document sending profiles for both disk and zip file storage
Fixes file names for electronic documents (XML) and PDF exports via Report Selections
No changes to procedure signatures or public events
Added comprehensive tests including unit tests and end-to-end scenarios
quote: PDF files must use the lower case `.pdf` extension.
